description: For 2 to 6 Steam profiles, show what a Steam Family would pool: shared library size, what each member gains and brings, games several members bought separately, and games excluded from Family Sharing.

items.description: A Steam profile URL (steamcommunity.com/id/name or /profiles/7656...), a custom URL name, or a SteamID64. The profile's Game details must be public.
